# Reassign tasks where someone agreed, and post thanks comment
# Based on analysis:
# 2851 -> Angelica Wilson (angelica.wils@gmail.com) - first name Angelica
# 2854 -> Matthew Blackburn (matthew.blac@gmail.com) - first name Matthew
# 2861 -> Sierra White (siwhit@gmail.com) - first name Sierra
# 2886 -> Kathryn Maldonado (kathrynmaldonado@gmail.com) - first name Kathryn

reassignments = {
    2851: ("angelica.wils@gmail.com", "Angelica"),
    2854: ("matthew.blac@gmail.com", "Matthew"),
    2861: ("siwhit@gmail.com", "Sierra"),
    2886: ("kathrynmaldonado@gmail.com", "Kathryn"),
}

for task_id, (email, first_name) in reassignments.items():
    # Reassign the task
    assign_resp = apis.todoist.assign_or_unassign_task(
        task_id=task_id,
        access_token=access_token,
        assignee_email=email
    )
    print(f"Assigned task {task_id} to {email}: {assign_resp}")
    # Post thanks comment
    comment_resp = apis.todoist.post_task_comment(
        task_id=task_id,
        content=f"Thanks {first_name}!",
        access_token=access_token
    )
    print(f"Posted comment on task {task_id}: {comment_resp}")
